description: Source file implementing functions for configuring and generating radio unit (RU) configurations, including dummy, high, low, and SDR configurations, for a flexible O-DU system in a 3GPP-compliant radio software project.

methods.name: generate_ru_dummy_config
methods.description: Generates a dummy radio unit configuration based on provided settings and cell configurations.

methods.name: fill_dummy_worker_manager_config
methods.description: Fills worker manager configuration with dummy RU settings.

methods.name: fill_dynamic_du_worker_manager_config
methods.description: Configures the worker manager for dynamic O-DU, handling different RU configurations such as SDR, OFH, and dummy.
